versions.changelog: - Security: output.folder path validation — rejects writes to sensitive directories (/etc, ~/.ssh, etc). Only allows ~/Documents, ~/Desktop, ~/Downloads, ~/.briefing-room, /tmp.

- Real-time X/Twitter trends (getdaytrends.com) and Google Trends RSS sections
- This Day in History section
- Host personality (configurable name)
- Now 11 sections (was 9)
- macOS only noted in description
- Clarified: 100% Free, TTS fully local, no paid APIs
- OpenClaw metadata added
- Auto-detect macOS voice for any language
- Fixed macOS grep -P incompatibility in trends
Config system, multi-language TTS, removed hardcoded values, code review fixes
Initial release: daily news briefing generator with audio + DOCX output
